function init()
    for _,rootFrame:Frame in ipairs(rootFrames) do
        for _,child:GuiObject in ipairs(rootFrame:GetChildren()) do
            local btn:GuiButton
            if child:IsA("Frame") then
                btn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                btn.ImageTransparency = 1
                btn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                btn.Parent = child
            elseif child:IsA("GuiButton") then
                btn = child
            else
                continue
            end

            btn.Activated:Connect(function(inputObject, clickCount)
                onTriggerBtn(child)
            end)
        end
    end

    -- if not isPC then
    --     UIInteractive.Size = UDim2.fromScale(UIInteractive.Size.X.Scale,0.75)
    -- end
end

function setBtnVisible(name:string,visible:boolean)
    for _,rootFrame:Frame in ipairs(rootFrames) do
        local child:GuiObject = rootFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
        if child then
            child.Visible = visible
        end
    end
end

function onTargetChanged()
    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand()
    -- if tool and tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then
    --     UIInteractive.Visible = false
    --     return
    -- end
    -- UIInteractive.Visible = true

    local target:Instance = v_dragItem.Value or InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget()
    local StoreVisible = false
    local UnstoreVisible = false
    local EatVisible = false
    local EquipVisible = false
    local DropVisible = false
    local HealVisible = false
    local ReloadVisible = false
    local VentVisible = false
    local enabled = false

    if target then
        enabled = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(target,DragItemValue.enable)
        if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(target) then
            local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(target)
            EquipVisible = resLo.IsTool or resLo.IsAccessory
            EatVisible = not resLo.IsTool and not resLo.IsAccessory and ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(target) and ResourcesItemHelper:IsCanEat(target)
        elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(target) then
            -- local craftLo = CraftItemHelper:GetLoByItem(target)
            EquipVisible = true
        end
    end


    if _inputType ~= GameEnum.InputType.Touch then
        -- 非手机端，在这里检测储存按钮显示
        StoreVisible = BagHelper:IsCanStore(target)
    end

    if tool then
        if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bag) then
            -- 装备了背包的处理
            if _inputType == GameEnum.InputType.Touch then
                -- 手机端，在这里检测储存按钮显示
                StoreVisible = BagHelper:IsCanStore(target)
            end
            UnstoreVisible = not target and not StoreVisible
        elseif tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Heal) then
            HealVisible = true
        elseif tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BarrelPistol4) then
            ReloadVisible = true
            local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
            VentVisible = resLo and (resLo.id == 614 or resLo.id == 615) or false
        end

        DropVisible = tool.CanBeDropped
    end

    -- Drag.Visible = v_dragItem.Value == nil and target ~= nil
    -- Undrag.Visible = v_dragItem.Value ~= nil

    -- Eat.Visible = enabled and EatVisible
    -- Take.Visible = enabled and ResourcesItemHelper:IsBullet(target)
    -- Equip.Visible = enabled and EquipVisible
    -- Drop.Visible = DropVisible
    -- Store.Visible = enabled and StoreVisible
    -- Unstore.Visible = UnstoreVisible
    -- Heal.Visible = HealVisible
    -- Reload.Visible = ReloadVisible
    -- Plant.Visible = enabled and target and target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TreeSeek)
    -- Dismount.Visible = humanoid.Sit
    -- btn_run.Visible = not isPC and not humanoid.Sit
    
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Drag,_inputType ~= GameEnum.InputType.Touch and v_dragItem.Value == nil and target ~= nil)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Undrag,v_dragItem.Value ~= nil)
    
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Eat,enabled and EatVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Take,enabled and ResourcesItemHelper:IsBullet(target))
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Equip,enabled and EquipVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Drop,DropVisible and not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding))
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Store,enabled and StoreVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Unstore,UnstoreVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Heal,HealVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Reload,ReloadVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Vent,VentVisible)
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Plant,enabled and target and target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TreeSeek))
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Dismount,character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding))
    setBtnVisible(BTN_NAME.Run,_inputType ~= GameEnum.InputType.Keyboard and not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding))
    -- print("BTN_NAME.Run",_inputType ~= GameEnum.InputType.Keyboard and not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding))

local function isRun()
	return character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WalkSpeedBuff.Run)
end

local function onRun()
	local Running = isRun()
    if not Running then
		GameHelper.SetCharacterRunC2S:FireServer(true)
    end
end

local function onStopRun()
	local Running = isRun()
    if Running then
		GameHelper.SetCharacterRunC2S:FireServer(false)
    end
end

function onTriggerBtn(gui:Frame)
    if not gui.Visible then return end
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end

    if gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Store or gui == btn_stone then
        local target:Model = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        if target then
            local curNum = BagHelper:GetHasNum()
            local maxNum = BagHelper:GetSize()
            if curNum < maxNum then
                task.spawn(function()

                    local originCFrame:CFrame = nil
                    if not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) and not table.find(_storeHideResItems,target) then
                        originCFrame = target:GetPivot()
                        -- print("暂时隐藏 originCFrame",originCFrame.Position)
                        target:PivotTo(originCFrame - Vector3.new(0,200,0)) -- 提前隐藏
                        table.insert(_storeHideResItems,target)
                    end

                    local suc:CFrame = BagHelper.BagStoreC2S:InvokeServer(target)
                    if suc then
                        BagHelper.onBagStore:Fire(target)
                    else
                        if not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) then
                            if originCFrame then
                                -- print("恢复限时 originCFrame",originCFrame.Position)
                                if target.PrimaryPart then
                                    target.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                    target.PrimaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                end
                                target:PivotTo(originCFrame) -- 储存失败，还原位置
                                local index = table.find(_storeHideResItems,target)
                                if index then
                                    table.remove(_storeHideResItems,index)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                UIHelper:PopCenterTips("The bag is full",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        end
        -- print(gui.Name)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Unstore then
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        local spawnCFrame:CFrame
        -- 射线检测
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local offsetY = Vector3.yAxis * 3
        local dir = cframe.LookVector * 3
        local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(cframe.Position + offsetY,dir,raycastParams)
        if hitResult then
            spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position)
        else
            spawnCFrame = cframe + dir + offsetY
        end

        BagHelper.BagUnstoreC2S:FireServer(spawnCFrame)
        -- print(gui.Name)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Eat then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        GameHelper.EatC2S:FireServer(target)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Equip then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        if target then
            if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(target) then
                local resLo = target and ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(target)
                if resLo.IsTool then
                    ToolHelper.PinkupToolC2S:FireServer(target)
                elseif resLo.IsAccessory then
                    ToolHelper.EquipAccessoryC2S:FireServer(target)
                end
            elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(target) then
                ToolHelper.PinkupToolC2S:FireServer(target)
            end
        end
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Take then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        GameHelper.TakeC2S:FireServer(target)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Drag then

    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Undrag then
		InteractiveHelper:UndragItem()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Plant then
        local treeSeek:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetTreeSeekPlantPoint(treeSeek)
        if groundPoint then
            GameHelper.PlantTreeC2S:FireServer(groundPoint,treeSeek)
        end
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Reload then
        GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Vent then
        SteamWeaponActionC2S:FireServer("BeginVent")
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Drop then
        ToolHelper.DropToolC2S:FireServer()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Dismount then
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Run then
        if isRun() then
            onStopRun()
            if gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
                gui.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            end
        else
            onRun()
            if gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
                gui.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function requestBackpackToggle()
    if not BackpackModeHelper:IsGameBackpack() then
        return false
    end

    local backpackScreen = UIHelper:GetScreen("UIBagpack")
    if not backpackScreen then
        return false
    end

    local gameBackpack = backpackScreen:FindFirstChild("GameBackpack")
    if not gameBackpack then
        return false
    end

    gameBackpack:SetAttribute("ToggleInventory", true)
    return true
end

local function requestUnequipTool()
    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if not tool then
        return false
    end

    ToolHelper.UnequipToolsC2S:FireServer()
    return true
end

function onInputBegan(input:InputObject, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    -- print(input.KeyCode)
	if not UIInterface.Enabled then
		return
	end

    if UIInteractive.Visible or UIInteractiveMobile.Visible then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
            if isRun() then
                onStopRun()
            else
                onRun()
            end
        else
            local btns = keybordInputBtns[input.KeyCode]
            if btns then
                for _,btn in ipairs(btns) do
                    onTriggerBtn(btn)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 手柄映射
        local btns = gamepadInputBtns[input.KeyCode]
        if btns then
            local handled = false
            for _,btn in ipairs(btns) do
                if btn.Visible then
                    onTriggerBtn(btn)
                    handled = true
                end
            end

            if not handled then
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
                    requestBackpackToggle()
                elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
                    requestUnequipTool()
                end
            end
        end
        -- if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3 then
        --     onTriggerBtn(btn_run)
        -- end
    end
end

local function isGamepadInputType(inputType)
    local inputName = inputType and inputType.Name
    return type(inputName) == "string" and inputName:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil
end

local function isKeyboardMouseInputType(inputType)
    return inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
end

local function shouldUseTouchUI(inputType)
    if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return true
    end
    if isGamepadInputType(inputType) then
        return false
    end
    return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
end

function onLastInputTypeChanged()
    local map
    local isgamepad = false
    local LastInputType = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
    local useTouchUI = shouldUseTouchUI(LastInputType)
    local newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.Keyboard
    if isGamepadInputType(LastInputType) then
        map = gamepadInputBtns
        isgamepad = true
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.GamePad
    elseif isKeyboardMouseInputType(LastInputType) then
        map = keybordInputBtns
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.Keyboard
    elseif useTouchUI then
        map = nil
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.Touch
    end

    if newInputType and _inputType ~= newInputType then
        _inputType = newInputType
        onTargetChanged()
    end

    UIInteractive.Visible = not useTouchUI
    UIInteractiveMobile.Visible = useTouchUI
        -- print("LastInputType",LastInputType)

    if map then
        for inputType:Enum.UserInputType,btns in pairs(map) do
            for i=1,#btns do
                local btn:GuiObject = btns[i]

                local img_icon:ImageLabel = btn:FindFirstChild("img_icon")
                if not img_icon then continue end

                local img_gamepadIcon:ImageLabel = btn:FindFirstChild("img_gamepadIcon")
                -- if not img_gamepadIcon then
                --     img_gamepadIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Name = "img_gamepadIcon"
                --     img_gamepadIcon.ImageTransparency = 0
                --     img_gamepadIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                --     img_gamepadIcon.AnchorPoint = img_icon.AnchorPoint
                --     img_gamepadIcon.SizeConstraint = img_icon.SizeConstraint
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Position = img_icon.Position
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Size = img_icon.Size
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Image = UserInputService:GetImageForKeyCode(inputType)
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Visible = false
                --     img_gamepadIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Parent = btn
                -- end
                -- print(img_gamepadIcon.Image,img_gamepadIcon.Image ~= "")
                if isgamepad and img_gamepadIcon then
                    local init = img_gamepadIcon:GetAttribute("init")
                    if not init then
                        img_gamepadIcon.Image = UserInputService:GetImageForKeyCode(inputType)
                        img_gamepadIcon:SetAttribute("init",true)
                        -- print("加载图片",inputType,img_gamepadIcon.Image)
                    end
                end
                if isgamepad and img_gamepadIcon and img_gamepadIcon.Image ~= "" then
                    img_gamepadIcon.Visible = true
                    img_icon.Visible = false
                else
                    img_gamepadIcon.Visible = false
                    img_icon.Visible = true
                end
                -- print("是否显示",img_gamepadIcon.Visible)
            end
        end
    end
    InteractiveHelper.isGamepad = isgamepad
    InteractiveHelper.onLastInputTypeChanged:Fire(isgamepad)
end

local UIInterface:ScreenGui = UIHelper:GetScreen("UIInterface")
if not UIInterface then return end

local UILeftFrame:Frame = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIInterface","UILeftFrame")
if not UILeftFrame then return end

local PlayerAttributeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerAttributeValue
local PlayerValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = LocalPlayer.Character
local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(LocalPlayer, PlayerValue.hunger)
local hungerColor1:Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
local hungerColor2:Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

local HeatFrame:Frame = UILeftFrame:WaitForChild("HeatFrame")
local HeatSlide:Frame = HeatFrame:WaitForChild("Slide")
local HeatCooldown:ImageLabel = HeatFrame:WaitForChild("img_cd")
local HeatStroke:UIStroke? = HeatFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
local heatRenderConnection:RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local tipHungry = true

local HEAT_MAX = 100
local HEAT_COOL_PER_SECOND = 14
local HEAT_STATE_NORMAL = "Normal"

function onRunChange()
    local img_run:ImageLabel = UILeftFrame.HungerFrame.img_run
    local img_cold:ImageLabel = UILeftFrame.HungerFrame.img_cold
    img_run.Visible = character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WalkSpeedBuff.Run)
    img_cold.Visible = character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed)
end

function onHungerChanged()
    local maxHunger = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(LocalPlayer,PlayerAttributeValue.maxHunger)
    local Slide:Frame = UILeftFrame.HungerFrame.Slide
    local alpha = math.clamp(v_hunger.Value / maxHunger, 0, 1)
    Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
    Slide.BackgroundColor3 = hungerColor2:Lerp(hungerColor1,alpha)
    
    if alpha > 0.2 then
        tipHungry = true
    elseif tipHungry and alpha <= 0.2 then
        UIHelper:PopCenterTips("You are hungry.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("玩家饥饿")
        tipHungry = false
        task.delay(20,function()
            tipHungry = true
        end)
    end
end

local function isSteamWeaponEquipped()
    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if not tool then return false end
    local itemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    return itemLo and (itemLo.id == 614 or itemLo.id == 615) or false
end

local function getDisplayedHeat(timeNow:number)
    local heat = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeat")) or 0
    local updatedAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatUpdatedAt")) or timeNow
    local coolStartAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatCoolStartAt")) or updatedAt
    local state = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatState") or HEAT_STATE_NORMAL
    local ventEndAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamVentEndAt")) or 0

    if state == HEAT_STATE_NORMAL then
        local coolingFrom = math.max(updatedAt, coolStartAt)
        if timeNow > coolingFrom then
            heat = math.max(0, heat - (timeNow - coolingFrom) * HEAT_COOL_PER_SECOND)
        end
    elseif ventEndAt > updatedAt then
        local remainingAlpha = math.clamp((ventEndAt - timeNow) / (ventEndAt - updatedAt), 0, 1)
        heat *= remainingAlpha
    end

    return math.clamp(heat, 0, HEAT_MAX), state, ventEndAt
end

local function stopHeatRender()
    if heatRenderConnection then
        heatRenderConnection:Disconnect()
        heatRenderConnection = nil
    end
end

local function renderHeat()
    local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local heat, state, ventEndAt = getDisplayedHeat(timeNow)
    local steamEquipped = isSteamWeaponEquipped()
    local visible = steamEquipped or heat > 0.01 or state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL

    HeatFrame.Visible = visible
    if not visible then
        HeatSlide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
        HeatCooldown.Visible = false
        HeatFrame.Rotation = 0
        if HeatStroke then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0
        end
        stopHeatRender()
        return
    end

    local alpha = heat / HEAT_MAX
    HeatSlide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
    HeatCooldown.Visible = state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL

    HeatCooldown.Rotation = 0
    if HeatCooldown.Visible then
        local pulse = (math.sin(timeNow * 10) + 1) * 0.5
        HeatCooldown.ImageTransparency = 0.05 + pulse * 0.2
    else
        HeatCooldown.ImageTransparency = 0
    end

    if HeatStroke then
        if state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0.1 + (math.sin(timeNow * 14) + 1) * 0.2
        elseif heat >= 70 then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0.15 + (math.sin(timeNow * 6) + 1) * 0.2
        else
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0
        end
    end
end

local function ensureHeatRender()
    if not heatRenderConnection then
        heatRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(renderHeat)
    end
    renderHeat()
end

onHungerChanged()
onRunChange()
HeatFrame.Visible = false
HeatSlide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
HeatCooldown.Visible = false
ensureHeatRender()

local function isRangedWeapon(tool:Tool?)
	return tool and (
		tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BarrelPistol4)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bow)
		or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gatlin)
	)
end

local function isMobileInput()
	if featureSwitch.Value then
		return UserInputService.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
	end
	return UserInputService.TouchEnabled
end

local function updateButtonImage(active:boolean)
	button.Image = active and states.ON or states.OFF
	button:SetAttribute("ShiftLockActive", active)
	button:SetAttribute("ManualDisabled", manualDisabled)
end

local function shouldBeActive()
	return isMobileInput() and next(activeReasons) ~= nil and not manualDisabled
end

local function shouldShowRangedCombatUI()
	return shouldBeActive() and activeReasons[RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON] == true
end

local function cancelOffsetTween()
	if offsetTween then
		offsetTween:Cancel()
		offsetTween = nil
	end
end

local function unbindOffsetRender()
	if offsetRenderBound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAMERA_OFFSET_BINDING)
		offsetRenderBound = false
	end
end

local function saveNativeState()
	if savedRotationType == nil then
		savedRotationType = UserGameSettings.RotationType
	end
	if humanoid and savedAutoRotate == nil then
		savedAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
		savedCameraOffset = humanoid.CameraOffset
	end
end

local function tweenCameraOffset(target:Vector3, duration:number)
	if not humanoid then return end
	cancelOffsetTween()
	if duration <= 0 then
		humanoid.CameraOffset = target
		return
	end
	offsetTween = TweenService:Create(
		humanoid,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{CameraOffset = target}
	)
	offsetTween:Play()
end

local function getShoulderWeight()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return 1 end
	local focusDistance = (camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude
	return math.clamp(
		(focusDistance - FIRST_PERSON_FADE_END) / (FIRST_PERSON_FADE_START - FIRST_PERSON_FADE_END),
		0,
		1
	)
end

local function bindOffsetRender()
	if offsetRenderBound then return end
	offsetRenderBound = true
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAMERA_OFFSET_BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		if not nativeModeActive or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
		local weightedOffset = SHOULDER_CAMERA_OFFSET * getShoulderWeight()
		if (weightedOffset - currentShoulderBase).Magnitude <= 0.001 then
			return
		end
		local oldBase = currentShoulderBase
		currentShoulderBase = weightedOffset
		humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", weightedOffset)
		-- Preserve an in-progress shake by moving its displacement along with the base.
		humanoid.CameraOffset += weightedOffset - oldBase
	end)
end

local function applyNativeShoulderMode()
	if not humanoid then return end
	saveNativeState()
	nativeModeActive = true
	humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
	pcall(function()
		UserGameSettings.RotationType = Enum.RotationType.CameraRelative
	end)
	humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	currentShoulderBase = SHOULDER_CAMERA_OFFSET * getShoulderWeight()
	humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", currentShoulderBase)
	tweenCameraOffset(currentShoulderBase, ENTER_TWEEN_TIME)
	bindOffsetRender()
end

local function restoreNativeState(immediate:boolean?)
	nativeModeActive = false
	unbindOffsetRender()
	cancelOffsetTween()

	local restoreHumanoid = humanoid
	local restoreOffset = savedCameraOffset or Vector3.zero
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = restoreOffset
	if restoreHumanoid then
		restoreHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", nil)
		restoreHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
		if savedAutoRotate ~= nil then
			restoreHumanoid.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate
		end
		if immediate then
			restoreHumanoid.CameraOffset = restoreOffset
			pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
		else
			local tween = TweenService:Create(
				restoreHumanoid,
				TweenInfo.new(EXIT_TWEEN_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{CameraOffset = restoreOffset}
			)
			offsetTween = tween
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if offsetTween == tween then
					offsetTween = nil
					pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
				end
			end)
			tween:Play()
		end
	end
	if savedRotationType ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			UserGameSettings.RotationType = savedRotationType
		end)
	end
	savedRotationType = nil
	savedAutoRotate = nil
	savedCameraOffset = nil
	currentShoulderBase = Vector3.zero
end

local function finishPendingRestore()
	if not humanoid or pendingRestoreCameraOffset == nil then return end
	cancelOffsetTween()
	humanoid.CameraOffset = pendingRestoreCameraOffset
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
end

local function cleanupPreviousCharacter(previousHumanoid:Humanoid?)
	if not previousHumanoid then return end
	if offsetTween then
		offsetTween:Cancel()
		offsetTween = nil
	end
	previousHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", nil)
	previousHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
	if savedAutoRotate ~= nil then
		previousHumanoid.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate
	end
	local restoreOffset = pendingRestoreCameraOffset or savedCameraOffset
	if restoreOffset ~= nil then
		previousHumanoid.CameraOffset = restoreOffset
	end
	if savedRotationType ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			UserGameSettings.RotationType = savedRotationType
		end)
	end
	savedRotationType = nil
	savedAutoRotate = nil
	savedCameraOffset = nil
	nativeModeActive = false
	currentShoulderBase = Vector3.zero
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
	legacyModeActive = false
	unbindOffsetRender()
end
